name: R.A.I.D
summary:
Step into the boots of an ESF customs agent in R.A.I.D. (Rapid Assault & Interception Division), a VR co-op shooter that combines cargo inspection, contraband detection, and explosive sci-fi combat.

Stationed aboard an orbital space station, you'll inspect incoming freighters from across the galaxy. Scan cargo, uncover illegal goods, and decide who passes inspection or who gets boarded. Follow protocol to climb the Ranger Ranks, or bend the rules for greater rewards at the risk of your reputation.
